youtube.title: Why onions make you cry (it's the droplets) #Shorts
youtube.description:
A lab study filmed an onion being cut and saw tiny droplets burst out at up to about 90 mph. A reaction in the cut onion makes an eye irritant that sets off tears. A sharper blade made fewer, slower droplets, but this is one preprint that tracked droplets, not tears.

#PanTheory #CookingScience #Onions #Shorts
